'''Radrrl''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who sought to spread the ideals of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. He was one of four Wookiees within his family.

==Biography==
[[File:EndorFamily.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Radrrl's family's home on Endor]]

During the Life Day festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Radrrl resided on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] with his family. His family included [[Oraalarri]], [[Anarra]] and [[Tebeurra]].

Oraalarri would have [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] speak to Radrrl and other members of his family to learn more about Life Day. Though naturally sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], due to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] enslavement of his [[Species/Legends|species]], he, like the rest of his family, welcomed Imperials to their home. They told these Imperials that while they themselves may not be bad people, corruption and darkness would consume them as they grow more powerful within the Empire.

==Behind the scenes==
Radrrl was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. During the Life Day event of [[2004]], players could talk to Radrrl on either Endor or Yavin 4 to learn about Life Day.
